searchText: Since we discussed [EIP-8253: Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8253) yesterday, initially rejected it for glam but kept the discussion open, I was looking into tests we may want to have when this eip ships: [tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md](https://github.com/nerolation/EIPs/blob/toni/add8253tests/tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md). This is independent from glam vs hegota. My opinion is that it's too late for glam, we're approaching testnets and shouldn't change the scope now. Still, the EIP is good and I'm for including it in hegota. cc <@508125616940515329> Hi all! Thanks for this doc, I was not aware this exists, great working document. We intent to get spec+tests done by ACDE. Likely not, I have linked your doc in the PR to ensure that your tests are in there once we merge this thing. It is still draft 🙂 I'll put an agent to work 🤖 😄 Hi all!

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
Since we discussed [EIP-8253: Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8253) yesterday, initially rejected it for glam but kept the discussion open, I was looking into tests we may want to have when this eip ships:
[tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md](https://github.com/nerolation/EIPs/blob/toni/add8253tests/tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md).
This is independent from glam vs hegota.

My opinion is that it's too late for glam, we're approaching testnets and shouldn't change the scope now. Still, the EIP is good and I'm for including it in hegota.
